title: Safe by default
description:
This temperature report compiles, but it relies on luck in three places. Make it correct **and** warning-free.

It reads three temperatures (decimals) and should print their average and how far the warmest is above the coldest. For `10 20 60`:

```
Average: 30
Spread: 50
```

Assume the three numbers are typed from coldest to warmest.
hints: `sum` is read before it has a value. Initialise it.
`spread` computes the answer and then forgets to hand it back. A function with a return type must `return` something on every path.
`count` is never used. Remove it and the last warning goes away.
rules: The compiler must report no warnings.
lessonTitle: Compiler Settings, Build Configurations and Undefined Behavior
